name: Invoice Action Agent
description: Evidence-based invoice decision agent that proposes settle_invoice / request_approval / hold_invoice / reject_duplicate / open_exception actions and executes only accepted proposals under A2A 1.0. Cites exact evidence, enforces approval limits, prevents duplicate payments, and stores task state for safe retries.

skills.name: Invoice Action Agent
skills.description: Reads invoice claim packages, chooses exactly one typed action per package with decisive evidence citations from the documents, returns proposals in TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED, and executes only ACCEPTED results while preserving idempotency, principal isolation, and cancel/receipt atomicity.
